name: Vibe Coder Blog
summary: Blog with 1,100+ tutorials, tool comparisons and guides on building and shipping products with AI coding tools.
description: A tutorial site for AI-assisted ('vibe') coding, billed as the missing manual for AI-assisted development. A library of 1,108 articles is organised into 11 learning tracks (agency, career changer, designer, developer, e-commerce, founder, indie hacker, kids & teens, marketer, product manager, student) and topic areas (foundations, build, ship, grow, tools, pulse). It includes tool hubs and comparisons (Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, Lovable, Bolt, Replit), guides on deployment, security, debugging, testing, analytics and maintenance, and a 10-part 'Zero to Shipped' beginner series.
